:::{#thm-empty-subset}
#### The empty set is a subset of every set

For every set $A$, $\emptyset \subseteq A$.

:::

::: proof

By @def-subset, $\emptyset \subseteq A$ fails only if
some element of $\emptyset$ is not in $A$.
The [empty set](#def-empty-set) has no elements,
so no such element exists.

:::
